notes.purpose: jaxfne/vis (excluding vis/plotly/) is the package's static/NumPy-isolated matplotlib visualization layer for simulation output: raster plots, Vm/rate/LFP/CSD/EEG/MEG traces, PSD/spectrogram, spectrolaminar suites, 3D network/column geometry, HDP diagnostics, tutorial/report figure assembly, and evidence/export bundling. Organized as one-file-per-concern (rasters.py, traces.py, spectra.py, fields.py, network3d.py) plus a canonical.py dispatch layer offering backend-agnostic entry points (plot_raster, plot_lfp, plot_psd, etc., default backend='plotly' per __init__.py lines 80-93/210) sitting on top of both the matplotlib-native modules and the separate vis/plotly/ subpackage. core.py (61 lines) supplies shared low-level utilities (FigureResult dataclass, require_matplotlib, close_all, prepare_static_plot_matrix for JAX-device-array-to-host extraction) used across the other modules. Larger files (fields.py 818 lines, traces.py 762, script_reports.py 707, tutorial_panels.py 697, network3d.py 684) hold clustered concerns rather than being further split.
key_findings: 18 real .py files in jaxfne/vis top level (excluding plotly/ subpackage, __pycache__, .DS_Store), totaling 6,268 lines per `wc -l jaxfne/vis/*.py`; largest are fields.py (818), traces.py (762), script_reports.py (707), tutorial_panels.py (697), network3d.py (684), canonical.py (426); smallest are layout.py (57), core.py (61)
